blocks.text: Jism ke bohat se endocrine glands master gland, yani pituitary gland, ke qaboo mein hain. Lekin yeh master gland khud dimagh ke ek hisse, hypothalamus, ke qaboo mein hai. Hypothalamus mein khaas neurosecretory cells hote hain jo sirf nerve impulses hi nahin chalate balke hormones bhi chhorte hain.

Do hormones, oxytocin aur antidiuretic hormone (ADH), hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells banate hain. In cells ke axons (lambe nerve dhaage) oxytocin aur ADH ko posterior pituitary tak le jate hain, jahan yeh jama rehte hain aur zaroorat par khoon mein chhore jate hain.

Khoon ki nalyan (blood vessels) hypothalamus ko anterior pituitary se jorti hain. Hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells aise hormones chhorte hain jo inhi nalyon ke zariye anterior pituitary tak jate hain. Yeh hormones do qism ke hain:

blocks.alt: Hypothalamus aur pituitary ki tarash. Hypothalamus mein neurosecretory cells (narangi sitare) hain. Zyada tar ke axons danthal (stalk) se neeche posterior pituitary mein jate hain; chand ke axons danthal ke oopar capillaries ke jaal par khatam hote hain. Aik artery is jaal aur anterior pituitary ko khoon deti hai; aik portal nali danthal ki capillaries se anterior pituitary ki capillaries tak jati hai. Doosri artery posterior pituitary mein aati hai; dono lobes ki veins neeche mil jati hain.

blocks.text: Khaake ko do raston mein parhein. Daen rasta (posterior pituitary): hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells khud oxytocin aur ADH banate hain aur yeh hormones lambe axons (nerve ke dhaagon) ke andar neeche posterior lobe tak pohanchte hain; wahan yeh jama rehte hain aur zaroorat par khoon (vein) mein chhoot'te hain. Baen rasta (anterior pituitary): chhote axons wale cells apne releasing ya inhibiting hormones danthal ke oopar capillaries mein dalte hain; wahan se portal nali (neeli) yeh hormones seedha anterior pituitary ki capillaries tak le jati hai. Is tarah anterior pituitary nerve se nahi balke khoon ki nali se qaboo hota hai.

items: Releasing hormones anterior pituitary ko hormones banane aur chhorne par uksate hain.
Inhibiting hormones anterior pituitary ke hormones ka banna aur chhootna rokte hain.

blocks.explanation: Yeh hypothalamus ke woh khaas cells hain jo nerve impulses bhi chalate hain aur hormones bhi chhorte hain, jaise oxytocin, ADH aur releasing/inhibiting hormones.

items: Pituitary master gland hai magar khud hypothalamus ke qaboo mein hai.
Posterior pituitary: oxytocin aur ADH hypothalamus mein bante hain aur axons ke zariye posterior pituitary mein jama hote hain.
Anterior pituitary: hypothalamus ke releasing aur inhibiting hormones khoon ki nalyon se pohanch kar is ke hormones ko chalate ya rokte hain.
